scope.response_definition: Sampled resp_len sum; supervised response spans, distinct from all rendered tokens
scope.packing_note: Next-token positions subtract one per target. Multipack/drop-last may leave positions unconsumed; not allocated per family here.
scope.inherited_source_attribution: Recovered remote sorted union verified against corrected log and local token probes
